race.title: Join Ladbrokes Bet 5 Pound Get 30 Pound Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: JET TO VEGAS pulled clear with an unexposed rival here 3 weeks ago and the Russell & Scudamore-trained gelding can continue his run of good form to score for the second time this autumn. Crebilly has proved most reliable this season and has to be respected after a small rise for his Wetherby win, while Somespring Special should be all the better for her recent outing. JET TO VEGAS (IRE) CREBILLY (IRE) SOMESPRING SPECIAL (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Fringill Dike (15/8), Crebilly (3/1), Jet To Vegas (10/3), Western Knight (8/1), Somespring Special (8/1), Thecompanysergeant (12/1)
